The '''Stronghold Cantina''' (also called Lok cantina<ref name="SonyCite-Aiding the Rebellion">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66934&resource=features|text=Aiding the Rebellion}}</ref> or Nym's Cantina<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Where are they? Famous Characters in Star Wars Galaxies">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68519&month=112009|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Where are they? Famous Characters in Star Wars Galaxies}}</ref>) was a popular establishment in the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] town of [[Nym's Stronghold]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. It was frequented by many members of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] and visitors.

The [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] was situated in the center of the small stronghold, not far from the bazaar, hotel and medical center. It had two entrances, one in the front and one in the back. The cantina featured of a large room with a long, U-shaped bar counter in the middle of the room where a bartender sold beverages. Six large booths along the walls provided tables and chairs where people could sit down, drink and listen to the music. A door behind the counter led to a small back room that wasn't in use as of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Another room in the back of the cantina gave special patrons a little privacy from the other patrons' prying eyes.

Among the beverages available at the bar were [[Antakarian Fire Dancer/Legends|Antakarian Fire Dancer]], [[Sith Scorcher/Legends|Sith scorcher]], [[Desert Bloom|Desert bloom]], [[Lopez Softdrink]], [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|Ardees Beverage tea]], [[Milk/Legends|milk]] and [[Jawa beer]].

==Inhabitants and patrons==
[[File:Nyms_Stronghold_cantina_interior.jpg|thumb|left|The interior.]]
Among the beings who visited this cantina regularly in 1 ABY were the retired [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Moore]], musician [[Vixur Webb]], retired [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Choster]], [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ramna]], the gambler [[Berema]], and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. The [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Kaibe]] could also often be found outside of the cantina.

==Behind the scenes==
This cantina is a location in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. The building's layout is identical to ''Star Wars Galaxies''{{'}} version of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]].

Various NPCs can be found here that players have to talk to during quests. It also provides a place for players of the [[:w:c:swg:Entertainer|entertainer profession]] to perform their music and dancing acts and give out buffs.
